name: DB-IP
tier_rationale: Established company with published terms, a privacy policy and a commercial offering; the Lite databases are published under CC BY 4.0 (A8 BR2).

reliability.justification: Commercial geolocation vendor; the Lite editions are country/ASN level and updated monthly.

lite.title: DB-IP Lite country and ASN databases (mmdb, monthly)

terms.quote: Registry terms: DB-IP Lite CC BY 4.0 (open), IPtoASN PDDL (open), bgp.tools free use with descriptive UA (open), GeoLite2 EULA (license).

lite.notes: Quote: binding council text (P047 cond 7); research C0082 terms 'CC BY 4.0 (attribution to DB-IP required)' (verified_live 200: country 4.2 MB gz, ASN 5.2 MB gz). Country + ASN only - the 86 MB city file is never fetched (P047 cond 1/8). The ASN file is dataset ip_offline_geo.dbip_asn_lite.mmdb. Attribution 'IP Geolocation by DB-IP (https://db-ip.com)' in reports and notices. Used by ip_offline_geo.

notes: Owned by batch p1-G02-2 (P047). Files are monthly (dbip-{country|asn}-lite-YYYY-MM.mmdb.gz; the new month appears on the 1st).
